audit_items.proof_trace: handle_withdraw removes ctokens before calling is_obligation_safe (L328 before L332), then asserts safety (L342). is_obligation_safe uses risk-weighted values: collateral deflated by collateral_factor (<1.0, enforced at emode creation by strict BPS check on L175) and debt inflated by borrow_weight (>=1.0, enforced on L178). At the safe/unsafe boundary where weighted equality holds, the raw debt/collateral ratio equals collateral_factor/borrow_weight which is strictly <1.0, so the property forall withdraw: post_debt/post_collateral < 1.0 is always satisfied when withdrawal is permitted.
